This scene:
在古代，很多医生不知道怎么用药。所以他们找到了很多植物对药。神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药。但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人。神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒。所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药。正好，他找到了一把花，他想把花放在茶里，对药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 所以他们找到了很多植物对药：来做药
- 神农先看到很多病人，他们吃很多植物对药：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears；吃了很多植物，了completed
- 但是我觉得他们的吃的植物，让他们病人：他们吃的植物让他们生病，让Sb. + V./Adj.
- 神农觉得这个植物可能特别是毒：可能毒性特别强，”特别是+N, + Clause” is used to single out a typical example
- 所以他想找一个植物对药，他们可以吃对药：找一个可以做药的植物；这样，他们可以……
- 他想把花放在茶里，对药：做成药

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很多植物对药：很多能做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot describe a plant’s medicinal use; “能做药的” correctly modifies “植物.” [rule: word_choice]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很多植物对药：很多能做药的植物，The phrase “对药” cannot describe plants that are used as medicine; “能做药的” forms the correct modifier before “植物.” [rule: word_choice]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们的吃的植物：他们吃的植物，A verb phrase used to modify a noun takes the pattern “verb + 的 + noun”; the extra possessive “的” after “他们” does not belong in this relative clause. [rule: attributive_modifier_de]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 让他们病人：让他们生病，“病人” is a noun meaning “patient,” so it cannot be the result after “让”; “生病” is the verb phrase meaning “become ill.” [rule: word_class_misuse]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 特别是毒：特别有毒，“毒” is not used as a predicate adjective here; “有毒” means “poisonous” and can follow “特别.” [vocab list]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个植物对药：一种能做药的植物，“对药” cannot express that a plant can be made into medicine; “能做药的植物” gives the plant this function, and “一种” is the suitable measure word for a kind of plant. [rule: word_choice]
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 吃对药：吃药，“对药” does not fit as the object of “吃”; “吃药” means to take medicine. [rule: word_choice]
8. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 对药：做药，“对药” cannot express the purpose of putting the flowers into tea; “做药” means “to make medicine.” [rule: word_choice]
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce the name together with a full noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
10. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 这个植物：这些植物，No particular single plant has been identified before this sentence, so the singular reference is unclear; the plural phrase refers clearly to the plants the patients ate. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
11. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他们可以吃药：病人可以吃药，Several groups have appeared between the earlier mention of the patients and this sentence, including doctors and 神农, so repeat “病人” instead of using an unclear pronoun. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
